item.title: Delhi-NCR Air Quality Deteriorates: AQI breaches 400 mark across multiple regions | Dynamite News
item.description: Delhi-NCR continues to choke under severe air pollution as AQI levels crossed 400 in several areas, according to CPCB data. Dense smog enveloped locations like Rohini, Mundka, Bawana, and parts of Ghaziabad and Noida, pushing air quality into the ‘severe’ category.

item.title: ED raids 40+ locations in Jharkhand and Bengal in major crackdown on coal mafia | Dynamite News
item.description: The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has launched a major crackdown on coal smuggling networks across Jharkhand and West Bengal. Raids were conducted at over 40 locations linked to coal mafia operatives, including premises associated with Anil Goyal, Sanjay Udyog, LB Singh, Amar Mandal, and others.

item.title: Gold prices fall across major cities as global rates decline; Check price here | Dynamite News
item.description: Gold prices in India dropped again on 21 November as global markets weakened due to a stronger US dollar and reduced investor interest. International gold rates slipped to $4,061.53 per ounce, leading to a decline in domestic prices across major cities. In Delhi, 24-carat gold fell to ₹1,24,400 per 10 grams, while 22-carat stood at ₹1,14,040.

item.title: 5.2-Magnitude quake hits Bangladesh; Strong tremors felt in Kolkata | Dynamite News
item.description: An earthquake of magnitude 5.2 struck Bangladesh on Friday morning, causing strong tremors across West Bengal, including Kolkata. Social media was flooded with posts and videos from users who claimed the quake felt powerful and lasted a few seconds.

item.title: Miss Universe 2025 Winner: Mexico’s Fatima Bosch outshines contestants from 130 Nations | Dynamite News
item.description: Miss Universe 2025 has crowned Fatima Bosch from Mexico as the winner, outshining contestants from 130 countries. The glamorous finale was held in Nonthaburi, Thailand, on 21 November. Miss Thailand (Pravener Singh) was the first runner-up, while Miss Venezuela and Miss Philippines secured second and third runner-up positions.

item.title: Jaish-e-Mohammed handler shared explosive training with Delhi blast doctor! | Dynamite News
item.description: A Pakistan-based Jaish-e-Mohammed handler, known as ‘Hanzulla’, shared bomb-making videos with Dr. Muzamil Shakeel, one of the accused in the Delhi Red Fort blast that killed 15 people. Shakeel, linked to a white-collar terror module at Faridabad’s Al-Falah University, allegedly recruited other doctors for the attack.
